Product details

SKU: IN220BT43ZDG

This Bioactive 100% Pure Collagen Peptides + Hyaluronic Acid + Vitamin C Wellness powder from INCA Organics has been formulated to nourish your skin and body from within. It contains a powerful trio that works in synergy from the inside out to support and maintain healthy skin, hair, nails, joints & mobility. This next level collagen powder contains two unique types of collagen peptides that have been formulated and backed by science to target specific areas in the body. The addition of Hyaluronic Acid has been shown to support skin hydration and joint lubrication whereas Vitamin C acts as a potent antioxidant and boosts the body's collagen production.

- Unflavoured, neutral tasting & versatile. Mixes easily into your beverage or food of choice

- 30 servings (high potency dose allowing you to achieve more with less)

- Paleo & Keto friendly

- Zero sugar & Fat

- Gut friendly & easy to digest

- Active Ingredients per serve: 7500mg Collagen Peptides, 60mg Hyaluronic Acid, 40mg Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)

- 18 amino acids (rich in glycine, proline, hydroxyproline)

- Two unique types of Collagen Peptides, ethically sourced from Germany

- Free from GMO, flavours, sugar, sweeteners, fat and preservatives. No added gluten, dairy or soy

- Halal and Kosher certified

Ingredients: Hydrolysed Bioactive Collagen Peptides (bovine) (98.7%) (Origin Germany), Hyaluronic Acid (0.8%), Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) (0.5%).

Suggested use: Mix 1-3 heaped teaspoons into your beverage or food of choice, stir for 20-30 seconds until dissolved. For best results enjoy 1 serve (3 heaped tsp/7.6g) daily. Maximum 2 serves a day.


Please note this supplement is not a sole source of nutrition and should be consumed in conjunction with a nutritious diet and appropriate physical exercise. Not suitable for Children under 15 years. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have a medical condition, consult a healthcare practitioner prior to use. Please note product is sold by weight and not by volume, contents will settle.

At THE ICONIC we do our best to provide you with accurate information about product ingredients, based on information provided to us by our Suppliers. For the most complete and up-to-date information, please refer to the product packaging.
